ai_summary: Mars to sponsor Gibbs at Bristol with M&M’s scheme in memory of Kyle Busch – NASCAR.com: The piece announces Mars’s sponsorship of driver Gibbs at Bristol, featuring an M&M’s tribute to Kyle Busch. It outlines the event’s commemorative focus and the partnership’s promotional aspects.
